params.requirement: Condenses the older part of an exchange with a model into a short plain report of what was said, in order, adding nothing and judging nothing. It needs faithful summarising over a transcript of several thousand tokens and must keep to a stated length. Nobody waits on it and it runs only when a cache has gone cold or a window has grown too long, so a small, inexpensive model is enough.

model.description: The summarizer's model; the template carries `ctx.model`, and the llm-registry may move it through the hive's `in_model` door.

description.purpose: The curator's own small model: it condenses the part of the wall a rebuild hands it, with the previous summary in front, into one report of what was said.
description.use_when: Inside the curator only, called by `./policy` once per rebuild.
description.not_in_scope: No tools, no identity, no judgement of truth. Not on the hot path: nobody waits on it.
description.emits_meaning: One assistant turn with the summary, `finish_reason` `stop`. Anything else (an error, a cut answer, an empty or over-long text) and the rebuild keeps the old window. A refused `in_model` push carries `hop.refused_subscriber` and leaves the hive on `model_refused`.
description.consumes_meaning: system.instructions.text: the summarizing contract with its length. messages[]: one user turn with the transcript. The one body without messages[] is a params-only push on the hive's `in_model` door (GH #858).
